guard: a failed afterRestore reports its own fixed metadata after verified source-byte restoration without replacing the mutant transcript or ERROR
why: The full maintained selftest runs the actual mutation-proof.mjs from TOOL, with commands and inner mutation targets confined to its own mkdtemp Git repository. No checker is copied.

The unique source-byte verification truth field is falsified only in the reporting record. The first red-mode bounded-metadata check requires true and names the failure without relaxing status, restoration, or privacy controls.
No completionMarker: the maintained selftest exits on its first failed assertion and cannot print its success banner on this named red.
After the outer tool restores its original checker bytes, the same full selftest runs again as afterRestore. A restoration failure remains ERROR, not a kill.

mutations.name: afterRestore observation denies the source-byte verification that preceded its command
mutations.expectRed: failed red afterRestore reports its own bounded fixed metadata
mutations.cell: failed red afterRestore reports its own bounded fixed metadata
